title: test_the_install_line_installs_the_tested_fork fails for b4
description: tests/patatt/test_patch_docs.py::test_the_install_line_installs_the_tested_fork[tree1-MarkAtwood/b4] fails on main with any ssh-keygen: the pinned commit differs from the b4 fork's commit (assertion at line 479).
